description: The plot illustrates training loss as a function of training steps for several different methods. The x-axis is labeled “Steps” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 2000, with tick labels at intervals of 200. The y-axis is labeled “Loss” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 10, with tick labels at intervals of 1. There are five lines displayed. A solid green line, representing “Vanilla”, begins at approximately 8.4 at step 0 and declines to approximately 0.8 at step 2000. A dashed red line, representing “Sep1.LM (n=380)”, starts at approximately 7.3 at step 0 and declines to approximately 0.7 at step 2000. A dashed-dotted blue line, representing “Sep1.LM (n=256)”, begins at approximately 7.7 at step 0 and declines to approximately 0.7 at step 2000. A solid orange line, representing “Sep8.LM (n=64)”, starts at approximately 7.4 at step 0 and declines to approximately 0.8 at step 2000. Finally, a dashed purple line, representing “Sep16.LM (n=32)”, begins at approximately 7.6 at step 0 and declines to approximately 0.9 at step 2000.
